categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC implementation in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp
categories.rationale: Fixes an assertion failure that crashes the daemon when invoking `dumptxoutset` with rollback on a pruned assumeutxo node. Returning a standard RPC error instead of terminating the process prevents a severe reliability failure during snapshot rollback.
